null.keys: prompt-only key at the last prompt position (the key cache's decode key) of every BEN-W row
null.sample: all rows of BEN-W (10_final/cache2/benign_parts): no BEN-W query is a probe query of the backbone's VLKEB family, so the sample is disjoint from the REPAIR pool and from every calibration draw of those logs (NOT of the MMKE-Bench logs: tests/t_parts.py, p9)

what.rescope: registered default method: normalised solver coordinate <W_i, k> / <W_i, k_i>
what.cosine: registered cosine gate: raw cosine to the stored solver key
what.cos_centred: cos(k - mu, k_i - mu), mu = mean BEN-W key
what.cos_null: cosine detector after the library's null repair (ridge 0) on the 100 keys of rescope_null (draw 0)
what.white_0.01: k_i' M k / k_i' M k_i, M = (C_W + rho I)^-1, rho = kappa tr(C_W) / d, kappa = 0.01
what.white_0.1: k_i' M k / k_i' M k_i, M = (C_W + rho I)^-1, rho = kappa tr(C_W) / d, kappa = 0.1
what.white_1: k_i' M k / k_i' M k_i, M = (C_W + rho I)^-1, rho = kappa tr(C_W) / d, kappa = 1
what.whitecos_0.01: cosine in the whitened space, kappa = 0.01
what.whitecos_0.1: cosine in the whitened space, kappa = 0.1
what.whitecos_1: cosine in the whitened space, kappa = 1
what.rescope_null: registered variant: default detectors after null repair on 100 REPAIR keys (teacher-forced), disjoint from the draw
what.rescope_nullW: default detectors after null repair on ALL 600 BEN-W keys (prompt-only keys)

e0_table_draw0.what: eta (4 decimals) and capped edits of draw 0, e0's gates built on the GPU

e0_table_20_draws.what: gate-level cells of table.txt section (1), mean [5th, 95th percentile] over the 20 draws, registered rows only

driver_rows.what: fx.methods.build(<registered row>, L, alpha = 0.05, n = 200, draw = 0): thresholds against the rows computed here

driver_gate_level.what: fx.gate.decide(L, gate, rows) == rescope.KeyCache.decide(gate, rows) for the new gates (two-block), per array
